output.reason: The migration guide only says the `IPWhiteList` middleware was renamed to `IPAllowList` with no configuration change [ev-bea0311eb482]. It does not say whether the old name stops being honoured, is rejected or still works as a deprecated alias. The CRD validator found spec.ipWhiteList in the traefik.io Middleware schema of both v2.11.2 and v3.0.0 [ev-4fd00a8d9fd6][ev-0842f8f3bd9d], and it refuted the rename because no version drops the field. So the evidence does not support the claim that "setting-ignored" (mandatory work) applies. To decide whether the consequence is setting-ignored, deprecation or none, we need upstream text or code showing what Traefik v3 does with a configured ipWhiteList.
